turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-10, the average non-cancelled order amount was 102.67 EUR for customers who signed up before 2026 (all in 2024) and 41.00 EUR for those who signed up in 2026, so the older customers' average was about 61.67 EUR higher (the difference is a subtraction of the two returned figures).
